why-asset-safe-tooltip:
The MainTreasury Smart Contract is a highly secure vault that safeguards all Hyperp user assets and Hyperp operational funds.
The MainTreasury Smart Contract's total balance will always surpass the combined assets of all Hyperp users, as their total assets are securely stored on the blockchain using zero-knowledge proofs.
